metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · The Tinder Swindler
metas.description: Posing as a wealthy, jet-setting diamond mogul, he wooed women online, then conned them out of millions of dollars. Now some victims plan for payback.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · The Perfect Neighbor
metas.description: A minor disagreement between neighbors in Florida takes a lethal turn, with police body camera footage and interviews probing the aftermath of the state's controversial "stand your ground" laws.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Girl in the Picture
metas.description: A young mother's mysterious death and her son's subsequent kidnapping blow open a decades-long mystery about the woman's true identity and the murderous federal fugitive at the center of it all.

metas.name: ★ 9.3 · 2026 · You Can See Everything
metas.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Lover Stalker Killer
metas.description: In this twisting documentary, a mechanic tries online dating for the first time and meets a woman who takes romantic obsession to a deadly extreme.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Maternal Instinct
metas.description: When a Texas state trooper pulled over a woman driving erratically on the highway in 2020, she claimed she had just given birth, but her story didn't add up.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · The Menendez Brothers
metas.description: In 1996, the Menendez brothers faced trial for killing their parents, a case that captivated America. Years later, they share their side through interviews with those involved, offering a fresh take on the events.
